text.zh: 摊开手掌看一眼。这只手上有 27 块骨头，两只手加起来 54 块，占全身 206 块骨头的四分之一还多。
text.en: Open your palm and look. There are 27 bones in this one hand — 54 in the pair, more than a quarter of all 206 bones you own.

text.zh: 手掌和手指占了 19 块。它们排成五列，每一列都能单独弯，所以你才能捏、勾、握、弹。
text.en: Palm and fingers account for nineteen. They line up in five columns, each able to bend on its own, which is why you can pinch, hook, grip and flick.

text.zh: 剩下 8 块挤在腕部，分两排堆在一起。手腕能绕这么多方向，靠的是这一小堆骨头彼此错动。
text.en: The remaining eight crowd into the wrist, stacked in two rows. The wrist turns in so many directions because this little heap of bones slides against itself.

text.zh: 往上是桡骨，在拇指这一侧。翻手掌时不是手腕在转，而是桡骨绕着尺骨转了半圈。
text.en: Above lies the radius, on the thumb side. When you turn your palm over, the wrist does not rotate — the radius swings half a turn around the ulna.

text.zh: 尺骨在小指这一侧，几乎不动，充当那根被绕着转的轴。两根骨头一动一静，才有了这个动作。
text.en: The ulna sits on the little-finger side and barely moves, serving as the axle the radius swings around. One bone turns, one holds still — that is the trick.

text.zh: 手指本身几乎没有肌肉。握拳时前臂的指浅屈肌先出力，它弯的是手指中间那一节，靠长长的肌腱远程拉动。
text.en: The fingers themselves carry almost no muscle. In a fist, flexor digitorum superficialis in the forearm pulls first, bending the middle joint of each finger through long, slender tendons.

text.zh: 前臂背面的指伸肌负责把手指拉直。手指之所以细，正因为发动机全都装在了远处。
text.en: On the back of the forearm, extensor digitorum pulls the fingers straight again. Fingers stay slim precisely because their engines are installed so far away.

text.zh: 再往上只剩肱骨一根。越靠近身体骨头越少越粗，越靠近指尖越多越细——手就是这样一路分岔出来的。
text.en: Higher up, only the humerus remains. Bones grow fewer and thicker towards the body, more numerous and finer towards the fingertips — the hand branches out along the way.

text.zh: 27 块骨头、几十条从远处拉过来的肌腱，凑成了这只能穿针也能提箱子的手。
text.en: Twenty-seven bones and dozens of tendons pulled in from a distance add up to a hand that can thread a needle and carry a suitcase.
